import numpy as np

print(f'p-value = {p:.4f}')
print(f'n = {len(steps)}')
print(f'95% CI: bootstrapping...')

# Bootstrap 95% CI for r
np.random.seed(42)
n_bootstrap = 10000
rs = []
for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
    idx = np.random.choice(len(seed1), size=len(seed1), replace=True)
    s1 = [seed1[i] for i in idx]
    s2 = [seed2[i] for i in idx]

# Also compute Spearman (rank correlation, more robust to outliers)
